paper_title: PM-KVQ Progressive Mixed-precision KV Cache Quantization for Long-CoT   LLMs
caption: : DeepSeek-R1-Distill-LLaMA-8B
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the sensitivity across different block indices for 4-Fbit and 8-Fbit configurations. The x-axis, labeled "Block Index," has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 31, with tick labels at 0, 7, 15, 23, and 31. The y-axis, labeled "Sensitivity," is on a logarithmic scale, spanning from 10^-6 to 10^-4, with major ticks at 10^-6, 10^-5, and 10^-4. Two sets of bars are depicted: green bars for 4-Fbit and blue bars for 8-Fbit. The green bars, representing 4-Fbit, are visible from block index 0 to 19, starting at approximately 7.0 × 10^-7 at block index 0 and increasing to around 7.0 × 10^-6 at block index 15, before decreasing slightly to about 6.0 × 10^-6 at block index 19. The blue bars, representing 8-Fbit, are visible from block index 20 to 31, starting at approximately 7.0 × 10^-6 at block index 20 and rising to around 7.0 × 10^-5 at block index 31.
